title: On Pretending to be asleep when they came
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：pretend　|　正文 360 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pretend 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the clerk ① pretended to be asleep when they came year after year, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② pretends to be asleep when they came for the whole place without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ pretend to be asleep when they came at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ pretended to be asleep when they came before — a line in the file for May 1972 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Pretending to be asleep when they came year after year, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ pretend to know the whole method for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Pretend to know the whole method at once and never mention it again.

By 1985 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ pretends to know the whole method year after year every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ pretended to be asleep when they came again when nobody else would.

⑩ To pretend to be asleep when they came, my mother said in 1990, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody pretends to be asleep when they came for the whole place again and somebody must pretend to be asleep when they came year after year all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 假装（一般过去式 pretended to be asleep when they came：1978 年书记员头一回这样做，年年地）
B. v. 假装（一般现在 pretends to be asleep when they came：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 假装（不定式 to pretend to be asleep when they came：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 假装（过去完成时 had pretended to be asleep when they came：1972 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 假装（动名词 pretending to be asleep when they came 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 自称（pretend to know the whole method：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去自称自称懂得整套做法）
G. v. 自称（pretend to know the whole method：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 假装（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 pretends to know the whole method，而母亲又一次 pretended to be asleep when they came）

answers.why: pretend 意为“假装”，1978 年书记员年年地假装他们进来时装作睡着，那是办事处里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 pretended。
pretend 意为“假装”，自那以后书记员替所有人把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 pretends。
pretend 意为“假装”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯假装他们进来时装作睡着”，此处为不定式 to pretend to be asleep when they came。
pretend 意为“假装”，卷宗里 五月 那行字说明早在 1985 年之前就有人假装过，故用过去完成时 had pretended。
pretend 意为“假装”，书记员说“假装他们进来时装作睡着这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 pretending to be asleep when they came 作主语。
pretend 意为“自称”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去自称自称懂得整套做法”，should ever 之后用原形 pretend to know the whole method。
pretend 意为“自称”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻自称自称懂得整套做法（pretend to know the whole method at once），以后再也不要提起。
pretend 意为“假装”，新来的申请人每个月份都照例自称自称懂得整套做法，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 pretends。
pretend 意为“假装”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次年年地假装他们进来时装作睡着，用一般过去式 pretended 叙述。
pretend 意为“假装”，结尾那句是母亲 1990 年的话：要假装他们进来时装作睡着，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 pretend 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the clerk pretended to be asleep when they came year after year, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk pretends to be asleep when they came for the whole place whenever the office asks.
Pretending to be asleep when they came year after year, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever pretend to know the whole method for the whole place, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office pretends to know the whole method year after year every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother pretended to be asleep when they came again, and the office remembered that half.
